Agreed next steps:
1) I'll send a short mutual action plan (attached) with stakeholders, decision criteria, and target timeline.
2) Rishi will provide a short ops doc on expected latency/throughput for your workload.
3) Jordan/Taylor to share procurement timeline and any contracting levers (PO timing, purchase window).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (simple timeline/stakeholders), redwood-pricing-accelerator.pdf (ballpark numbers + configuration options).

Proposed times for a short demo of the Dedicated flow + console (30m): Thu 6/17 10am PT or Mon 6/21 11am PT — happy to accommodate other times. Ideally we'd confirm demo before month-end to align with EOQ procurement.

If priorities changed, please let me know — otherwise I'll follow up next week to lock a slot.
